kultivator.sosok.setelan.detail.tip: How alive disciples and human NPCs are drawn: swaying hair and robes, faces that blink and talk, work motions, props in hand. The nearer the camera, the more complete; far ones are skinned silhouettes only.
kultivator.sosok.setelan.detail.jarak: Full up to %s blocks, reduced up to %s blocks, silhouette up to %s blocks
kultivator.sosok.setelan.detail.jumlah: Full animation for at most the %s nearest, swaying hair/robes %s, skins kept %s
kultivator.sosok.setelan.detail.catatan: Auto follows Effect Quality: Maximal = High, Normal = Medium, Minimal = Low. Minimal effects always use Low.
kultivator.sosok.setelan.wajah.tip: Blinking, glances, mouths that move while speaking and faces that follow the mood. Off: still faces (slightly cheaper).
kultivator.sosok.klien.lod: Level-of-detail labels show above every body for 30 seconds.
kultivator.sosok.klien.muat_ulang: Every body skin released; the recipe and part sheets are read again when bodies come into view.
kultivator.sosok.klien.bingkai: Body and outfit cube outlines show for 30 seconds.
kultivator.sosok.klien.info.susun: Composing, last 5 seconds: average %s ms, max %s ms, %s times (budget %s per frame, %s ms)
kultivator.sosok.klien.info.gerak_rusak: Animation or a body layer was turned off for this session after an error (see the log); /sosok muat_ulang turns it back on.
kultivator.sosok.klien.info.rusak: The skin composer was turned off for this session after an error (see the log); bodies wear fallback skins.
kultivator.sosok.klien.dump.tidak_ada: Look at a body wearing a Sosok skin (within reach of your view) and try again.
kultivator.sosok.klien.dump.benih: Seed skin written to %s (compare it with the Python preview of the same seed)
kultivator.sosok.klien.dump.benih_salah: Invalid seed or look key. Example: /sosok dump benih 123457 murid.2
